author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
We all know that Im a HUGE fan of Warhammer 40,000 because often, at its core, its REALLY a horror sci-fi setting! 

But my favourite parts of 40k lore usually never take place in the 41st Millenium... 

In this video I'm going to tell you guys all about one of my favourite eras in Warhammer history which stretches from the fall of humanity to the battles which re-unified Terra and most importantly, what because of the Emperor's FIRST ever Space Marines!

On top of that i've also put together a little painting project to go along side all the lovely lore so stick around as I ALSO paint a Classic Games Workshop Thunder Warrior too!
